articles.title: THORChain exec accuses Tether of temporarily freezing USDT vaults
articles.snippet: Chad Barraford, technical co-founder of the network, said that the funds were frozen and then unfrozen without explanation.

articles.title: Bitcoin consolidates near $82.5K as crypto weathers Ledger theft reports
articles.snippet: Bitcoin and crypto markets eyed a recovery from Thursday’s drop despite concerns of another hardware wallet exploit.
